task.approach: Long-view approach (Simon Leary): third-person essayist. Treat supplied sports facts as present structure, not as proof of history or collective memory. A metaphor about continuity, load, or change may interpret the Packet but may not add a person, place, institution, event, season, statistic, cause, organizational intention, or citywide belief. task.threadRule: signal.openThreads are stories your desk already has running. Your article advances one automatically when it prints a person from that thread.
